acceptance: All available required static checks pass, no unresolved required static check, and at least one registered matching behavior suite passes completely

behavior_benchmark.execution: Only locally authored registry functions through a credential-free child process; no arbitrary package code execution
behavior_benchmark.status: Owned executable fixtures, not twelve natural community Skills
behavior_benchmark.truth: Fixed constructive arithmetic/list/graph constraints, separate from implementation variants

limitations: Diagnostic faults and task fixtures are researcher constructed
Passing a finite suite is conditional evidence, not a permanent capability or security certificate
Original heuristics are the project's heuristic implementation, not a reproduction of published SkillNet or SkillCT evaluators
natural_packages: Frozen D1 200 originals; read-only diagnosis without newly invented semantic gold
purpose: A runnable defect and task-readiness discriminator, not a general learned quality model

static_benchmark.status: constructed diagnostic benchmark; no independent human semantic labels
static_benchmark.truth: Known independent edits plus a native argparse reference constructed from generator specifications, without the detector AST extractor

threshold_learning: none; fixed logical veto and conjunctive acceptance, not fitted on test outcomes
unknown: Unsupported contracts and missing task outcomes remain unknown; never convert absence of evidence into good or bad
veto: Any confirmed material defect or matching task failure prevents a tested-pass decision; document averages cannot offset it
